transcript.content: Hi, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess... work told me I needed to come. We had a staff meeting and... well, I got kind of worked up. 

I started acting out this whole fall-prevention drill right in the middle of it. Moving chairs around, waving my arms... Folks kept telling me to sit down, but I... I couldn't seem to stop. So, now I'm here.
Around the time this happened, did you feel unusually energetic or keyed up?

I suppose... yeah. Just some high-energy days, I guess. 

I'd be... cleaning the closets out. Rewriting all my care checklists. I even started planning this health fair for the church... calling folks up before breakfast. I just... I felt like it all had to happen right then. That's all.
During those high-energy days, did you feel like you had special powers or an unusually important mission?

I wouldn't say special powers. I just... I don't know. I get this strong feeling sometimes. 

Like I understand safety and caring for the old folks way better than the people with the titles do. It just feels like... like I was picked to fix the whole senior center. If they'd just listen to me. But I wouldn't call it a mission or anything like that. Just... knowing how it should be done.
During those high-energy times, did you need less sleep than usual?

I suppose... yeah. Didn't need much. Maybe two or three hours. 

I'd wake up way before dawn, and... I don't know, I just felt ready to go. Didn't seem like anything was wrong with it to me... just being up in the dark, getting my plans together while the house was quiet.
Did that high-energy period last a full week or longer?
I guess... yeah. It was probably about that long. Maybe a little more. I didn't exactly mark it on a calendar.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people did not when you were not having one of those high-energy periods?

I guess... yeah. There was a stretch where things were calmer. I was sleeping regular... wasn't rushing around with all those plans. 

But... for a few weeks during that time... I'd still hear my name being called out. And... I don't know, I was just sure the people at work were keeping notes on me. Even when I was calm.
When you were calm and sleeping normally, did the voices or the feeling that people at work were keeping notes on you continue for at least two weeks?
Yeah... I'd say so. It was a few weeks, at least. Even when I wasn't all wired up, those things were still happening.
When you were in those high-energy periods, did you also hear your name being called?

Yeah. Even when I was... fired up like that, hardly sleeping and trying to get all my plans going... I still heard it. And I was... pretty sure my supervisor was setting traps for me, too. It didn't stop just because I had energy.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
No... I don't really get like that. I mean, everybody gets down sometimes, but... I haven't been just sad all day for weeks straight or anything.
Outside of those high-energy periods, have you ever had times when hearing your name or feeling watched happened while your mood felt completely normal?

Yeah... I think I already said that. There was a time when I wasn't all wound up, sleeping okay, not doing all those projects... but it was still happening. For a few weeks, anyway. I'd hear my name, and... I just knew they were keeping notes on me at work. My mood was fine, but... that stuff didn't stop.
During that few-week period when you were hearing your name and thought people at work were keeping notes on you, was your mood completely normal?
Yeah... like I said... my mood was fine. I was sleeping alright, not doing all that running around. But... for those few weeks, I still heard it. And I still knew they were watching me at work.
